chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥadīd, from some of his men, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said: A man enters the bathhouse, and the bathhouse attendant pours hot water over him, so the hair of his head falls out and does not grow back. He said: “The full indemnity is upon him.”

key_terms.الدِّيَةُ: the prescribed indemnity for bodily injury
key_terms.فَلَا يَنْبُتُ: so it does not grow back

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone causes another person’s head hair to fall out permanently?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning bodily injury caused by another person. It states that if hot water is poured on a man in the bathhouse and the hair of his head falls out permanently, the one responsible is liable for the full diya.
